answer_1.quote: We analyze responses from DialoGPT and humans to English Twitter posts.

answer_2.quote: The resulting BERT-based classifier has an overall dev F 1 score of 83.3% and a test F 1 score of 80.0% for ad hominems.

answer_4.quote: We ask annotators on Mechanical Turk to read a post and response and determine whether the response contains any ad hominem(s) towards the person who made the post.
answer_4.guideline: Label the coherence of the response (independent of the post), on a scale of 1 to 5. Label how relevant the response is to the post, on a scale of 1 to 5.
